nodes.name: 001-create-projects.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 1: creates the STRICT `projects` table (id, title, CHECK-limited description, timestamps, canvas viewport x/y and zoom) plus the updated_at ordering index. The description CHECK is written literally at 280 characters so the recorded migration means the same thing in every database.
nodes.languageNotes: SQLite STRICT tables enforce declared column types; CHECK limits are literal because a migration ledger records only that a named migration ran.

nodes.name: 002-create-bubbles.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 2: creates the STRICT `bubbles` table owning bubble content (title, optional summary, content), canvas position, timestamps, and discussion-extraction provenance columns (source_kind, source_discussion_id, JSON source_message_ids), cascading from `projects`.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON-array validity is enforced in SQL with json_valid/json_type rather than trusted from the service layer.

nodes.name: 003-create-bubble-links.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 3: creates the STRICT `bubble_links` join table for undirected manual links between two bubbles, with a canonical-ordering CHECK (bubble_a_id < bubble_b_id), a project-scoped uniqueness constraint, and composite foreign keys that keep both endpoints inside the same project.
nodes.languageNotes: A composite FOREIGN KEY (bubble_id, project_id) requires a matching UNIQUE index on the parent, which this migration adds to `bubbles` first.

nodes.name: 007-complete-discussion-extraction-provenance.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 7: completes bubble extraction provenance by adding source_context_item_ids, source_discussion_title, source_discussion_deleted_at, and latest_extraction_id to `bubbles`, backfilling legacy discussion-sourced rows, and installing INSERT/UPDATE triggers that reject any row mixing manual and discussion provenance.
nodes.languageNotes: A trailing self-update (`SET source_kind = source_kind`) forces the new UPDATE trigger to validate every existing row, so the migration fails loudly if backfill left an invalid state.

nodes.name: 004-create-discussions.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 4: creates the STRICT `discussions` table with project scoping, optional generated title, a JSON-object frozen_context column, last_activity_at ordering, and soft-delete support, plus a partial activity index excluding deleted rows.

nodes.name: 005-create-discussion-messages.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 5: creates the STRICT `discussion_messages` table holding immutable turns with role, content, pending/completed/failed status, and a per-discussion unique request_id enforcing turn idempotency.

nodes.name: 006-persist-discussion-context-items.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 6: moves frozen context into its own `discussion_context_items` table, adds context_version, expected_context_item_count, and creation idempotency columns to `discussions`, and installs triggers guaranteeing context metadata is wholly null or wholly populated, finalized atomically, immutable afterwards, and backed by a contiguous, single-project-description item set.
nodes.languageNotes: SQLite triggers with `SELECT CASE ... THEN RAISE(ABORT, ...)` express multiple independent invariant checks inside one UPDATE guard.

nodes.name: 010-persist-discussion-search-attribution.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 10: adds per-turn web search attribution to `discussion_messages` (web_search opt-in, web_search_used, size-capped JSON citations) and installs triggers that reject role-inconsistent attribution and make the three columns immutable after insert.

nodes.name: 009-create-documents.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 9: creates the STRICT `documents` table modeling the durable processing job — original-file reference, format and size, source and processed hashes, processing status/error/retryability, generation, attempt count, and lease owner/expiry — with table-level CHECKs encoding every legal processing/ready/failed state and triggers guarding source immutability and generation transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: The whole document processing state machine (lease, generation, attempt monotonicity) is expressed as SQLite CHECK constraints and triggers, so a stale worker cannot write an illegal transition even if service code is wrong.

nodes.name: 008-create-knowledge-extraction-attempts.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 8: creates the STRICT `knowledge_extraction_attempts` table storing the immutable JSON source snapshot, generated proposal, attempt status, resolution fingerprint/kind/resulting bubble, retry count, and expiry, with per-discussion idempotency uniqueness, structural json_extract CHECKs on the snapshot, and triggers enforcing project scope and snapshot immutability.
nodes.languageNotes: CHECK constraints use json_extract/json_type to validate the shape of a stored JSON snapshot and cross-check its embedded ids against the row columns.

nodes.name: 011-persist-extraction-intent.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 11: persists user extraction intent by adding trimmed, length-limited `instructions` and a tight/standard/detailed `detail_level` to `knowledge_extraction_attempts`, then recreating the source-immutability trigger so the new intent columns are also frozen after insert.
nodes.languageNotes: The only migration in the set that interpolates a shared constant into its SQL — the instructions length limit imported from knowledge-extraction.types.

nodes.name: 012-widen-project-description.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 12: widens the `projects` description CHECK from 280 to 800 characters using SQLite's documented table-rebuild procedure — build `projects_rebuilt`, copy rows, drop the original, rename in last, recreate the ordering index — so child REFERENCES clauses stay pointed at `projects`.
nodes.languageNotes: Replacing a CHECK in SQLite requires rebuilding the table; the drop is only safe because runDatabaseMigrations suspends foreign key enforcement, otherwise the implicit DELETE would cascade across every child table.

nodes.name: 013-repair-project-foreign-keys.ts
nodes.summary: Migration 13: repairs child foreign keys rewritten by the first deployed version of migration 012, using a legacy_alter_table rename round trip that redirects references to the discarded temporary table back to `projects` while leaving already-correct schemas untouched.
nodes.languageNotes: PRAGMA legacy_alter_table toggles whether ALTER TABLE ... RENAME rewrites references in other tables' SQL — exploited here as a targeted repair.

nodes.name: database.migrations.ts
nodes.summary: Central migration registry and runner: declares the ordered DATABASE_MIGRATIONS list (versions 1-13, each imported from its owning feature) and runs pending migrations inside one IMMEDIATE transaction against the authoritative `schema_migrations` ledger, mirroring the result into PRAGMA user_version.
nodes.languageNotes: Foreign key enforcement is suspended around the whole run because PRAGMA foreign_keys is a no-op inside a transaction; PRAGMA foreign_key_check after commit turns a bad migration into a loud failure instead of silent corruption.

nodes.name: database.migrations.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive unit suite for the migration runner and every registered migration: verifies consecutive versioning, ledger consistency, idempotent re-runs, user_version mirroring, rollback on failure, and the CHECK constraints and triggers each migration installs.

nodes.name: knowledge-extraction.controller.ts
nodes.summary: NestJS controller for project- and discussion-nested knowledge extraction routes: POST creates a proposal, POST :extractionId/resolution resolves it, and DELETE :extractionId discards it, delegating entirely to the extraction and resolution services.

nodes.name: knowledge-extraction.module.ts
nodes.summary: NestJS module wiring the knowledge-extraction feature: imports Ai, Bubbles, Projects, and Discussions modules, registers the controller and both services, and binds the KNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTION_REPOSITORY token to the SQLite repository via useExisting.

nodes.name: knowledge-extraction.prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Owns the knowledge-extraction prompt surface: grounding and output instructions, the structured-output JSON schema for a title/summary/content proposal, detail-level guidance, and buildKnowledgeExtractionModelInput which serializes a source snapshot into model input.
nodes.languageNotes: User instructions are fenced between UNTRUSTED_USER_INTENT_BEGIN/END markers and JSON-encoded, keeping user intent syntactically separate from system instructions.

nodes.name: knowledge-extraction.prompt.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit suite for the extraction prompt builder: asserts the serialized snapshot layout, structured-output format, detail-level guidance selection, and that optional user instructions are wrapped in untrusted-intent markers.

nodes.name: knowledge-extraction.service.ts
nodes.summary: Core knowledge-extraction workflow service: validates and normalizes extraction requests, builds an immutable source snapshot from discussion messages and frozen-context items, enforces per-discussion idempotency with replay/retry, tracks in-flight generations, calls the model for structured output, and normalizes the resulting proposal.
nodes.languageNotes: Runtime validation is done by hand (isRecord, rejectUnknownFields, identifier arrays) rather than a validation library, matching the project rule that TypeScript types are not validation.

nodes.name: knowledge-extraction.types.ts
nodes.summary: Feature-local type surface for knowledge extraction: snapshot input, message and frozen-context snapshot shapes, the versioned source snapshot, attempt status and resolution kinds, the KnowledgeExtractionRepository port, its DI token, and the integrity error thrown on corrupt persisted rows.

nodes.name: sqlite-knowledge-extraction.repository.ts
nodes.summary: SQLite implementation of the KnowledgeExtractionRepository port: explicit parameterized SQL for creating attempts, project/discussion-scoped lookups by id or idempotency key, and status transitions (retry, save proposal, fail, resolve, discard), with exhaustive runtime parsing that rejects corrupt rows as integrity errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Every column read back from SQLite passes narrow type guards (isNormalizedText, isFingerprint, isIsoTimestamp) before becoming a domain object, so persisted corruption surfaces as a controlled repository failure.

nodes.name: projects
nodes.summary: Root ownership table for a project: id, title, length-checked description, timestamps, and persisted canvas viewport position and zoom. Every other feature table cascades from it.

nodes.name: bubbles
nodes.summary: Stores a project's knowledge bubbles: title, optional summary, non-empty content, canvas position, timestamps, and discussion-extraction provenance (source kind, discussion id, JSON message ids). Later extended by migration 7.

nodes.name: bubble_links
nodes.summary: Undirected manual links between two bubbles in the same project, canonically ordered (bubble_a_id < bubble_b_id) and unique per project pair, with composite foreign keys preventing cross-project links.

nodes.name: discussions
nodes.summary: Project-scoped focused discussions: optional generated title, JSON-object frozen context, created/updated/last_activity timestamps, and soft-delete marker driving the Active ordering model.

nodes.name: discussion_messages
nodes.summary: Immutable discussion turns: role, content, pending/completed/failed status, and a per-discussion unique request_id used as the turn idempotency key. Extended by migration 10 with web search attribution.

nodes.name: discussion_context_items
nodes.summary: Per-discussion frozen context snapshot rows — one project_description plus bubble and document copies — ordered by a contiguous display_order and unique per (discussion, source kind, source id).

nodes.name: documents
nodes.summary: Document library records combining upload metadata (title, original filename, opaque file reference, format, size, source hash) with the durable processing job state: status, error code and retryability, extracted text, generation, attempt count, and lease owner/expiry.

nodes.name: knowledge_extraction_attempts
nodes.summary: One knowledge-extraction attempt per (project, discussion, idempotency key): immutable JSON source snapshot, generated proposal, attempt status, retry count, expiry, and resolution fingerprint/kind/resulting bubble id once resolved. Extended by migration 11 with instructions and detail level.

nodes.name: schema_migrations
nodes.summary: Authoritative migration ledger created by the runner before anything else: one row per applied migration with version, unique name, and applied_at. PRAGMA user_version only mirrors it.

nodes.name: validateMigrationDefinitions
nodes.summary: Guards the registered migration list at startup: versions must be consecutive from 1 and names must be unique and non-empty, throwing before any SQL runs.

nodes.name: validateAppliedMigrations
nodes.summary: Compares the persisted schema_migrations ledger against the registered list, rejecting non-consecutive ledgers, databases newer than the application supports, and version/name mismatches.

nodes.name: runDatabaseMigrations
nodes.summary: Public entry point that applies pending migrations: validates definitions, suspends foreign key enforcement around the transaction so table rebuilds cannot cascade-delete data, then runs PRAGMA foreign_key_check after commit and throws on any violation.

nodes.name: runMigrationTransaction
nodes.summary: Runs the whole pending set inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction: creates the ledger, validates applied rows, rejects a future user_version, executes and records each pending migration in order, sets user_version, and rolls back on any failure.

nodes.name: buildKnowledgeExtractionModelInput
nodes.summary: Turns a versioned extraction source snapshot plus instructions and detail level into structured-output model input, serializing selected messages and frozen context as labeled JSON blocks and fencing optional user instructions as untrusted intent.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionController
nodes.summary: HTTP boundary for knowledge extraction nested under projects/:projectId/discussions/:discussionId, exposing create, resolve, and discard and delegating each to a service without duplicating validation.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionModule
nodes.summary: NestJS module class declaring the knowledge-extraction feature graph: imported modules, controller, providers, repository token binding, and the single exported service.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionService
nodes.summary: Owns the extraction workflow end to end: input validation and normalization, source snapshot construction from discussion messages and frozen context, idempotent replay and retry, in-flight generation deduplication, model invocation, and proposal normalization into the API response shape.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionIntegrityError
nodes.summary: Stable application error with code KNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTION_CORRUPT, raised when a persisted extraction attempt is incomplete or corrupt so SQL details never leak to callers.

nodes.name: SqliteKnowledgeExtractionRepository
nodes.summary: Concrete SQLite adapter behind the KnowledgeExtractionRepository port: explicit parameterized statements for insert, scoped lookup, and each status transition, plus strict row parsing that converts corrupt persisted values into integrity errors.
